A_keep_current_pe.note: verified; zero_skip gates product (coarse skip only)

B_modified_zero_aware_mac.note: +per-PE zero detect; energy-only, ~0 on DSP48E2, no cycle gain

C_mask_routing.note: mask alongside activations; same as B unless it compacts (breaks WS)

D_compacted_sparse.note: SCNN-style crossbar; sparse 2.44x (theor) / 1.88x (est); abandons systolic OS/WS

rationale: The PE already supports OS+WS+reconfiguration (the project's actual contribution). Fine-grained activation sparsity requires compaction (data-dependent timing), which is incompatible with the fixed-timing systolic OS/WS datapaths; options B/C add no cycle savings (and ~0 energy on DSP48E2), and option D abandons OS/WS for a different accelerator. No PE modification produces a meaningful OS+WS+sparsity win on the same datapath.
